description: This Java class implements a cache for expiring values utilizing Spring's Cache abstraction. It provides methods to insert values with expiration times or maximum ages, and to retrieve values while handling expiration logic. The class is generic over key and value types.

classes.name: SpringBasedExpiringValueCache
classes.description: A generic cache implementation for expiring values based on Spring's Cache abstraction. It supports inserting values with specific expiration times or maximum ages and retrieving values with automatic expiration handling.

methods.name: SpringBasedExpiringValueCache
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache with a given Spring Cache instance.
